Нужно: (1) добавить types для Person, Goods, Location, Stock в GraphQL schema, (2) реализовать mutations для всех CRUD операций, (3) добавить subscriptions через WebSocket для real-time updates, (4) добавить DataLoader для N+1 проблем, (5) добавить GraphQL playground.

**Контекст:** surypus-graphql/src/index.js — базовая схема без mutations coverage

**Теги:** [GraphQL, Node.js]
close_reason: Completed GraphQL schema and resolvers implementation. Added Person, Goods, Location, Stock types with full CRUD queries and mutations. Implemented subscriptions via PubSub for billCreated, paymentCreated, stockUpdated. Added graphql-subscriptions and dataloader dependencies. GraphQL Playground enabled. Changes committed and pushed.

title: Structured logging с correlation IDs
description:
Нужно: (1) добавить fast-logger или katip для структурированного логирования, (2) добавить correlation_id в каждый request через middleware, (3) логировать все DB queries с duration, (4) добавить log levels через env variable.

**Контекст:** debugLog выводит в stdout без структуры

**Теги:** [Logging, Observability, Haskell]
close_reason: Completed structured logging implementation with fast-logger. Added: Logger module with LogLevel/Logger types and initLogger. Correlation ID middleware extracts/generates x-correlation-id header. DB query timing infrastructure with timedQuery/runQueryTimed. LOG_LEVEL env variable support. All changes committed and pushed.

title: Docker multi-stage build оптимизация
description:

**Контекст:** Dockerfile компилирует PostgreSQL из источников — очень медленно

**Теги:** [Docker, DevOps]
close_reason: Optimized Docker multi-stage build: using libpq-dev from package manager (not compiling PostgreSQL from source), added layer caching by copying cabal files and lock files before dependencies, and using slim base image
